column3: NKJV follows the traditional reading “shall not alight” (written “to him it will come”).
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV reorders the verse, beginning with “He who sends a message.”
The verse is obscure; NKJV renders “The great God who formed everything Gives the fool his hire,” quite different from “an archer who wounds everyone.”
Close to the Hebrew; the second “lion” is rendered “A fierce lion.”
Close to the Hebrew; זִקִּים (“firebrands”) is rendered “firebrands.”
Close to the Hebrew; “burning lips” is rendered “Fervent lips,” and NKJV reorders the verse.
Close to the Hebrew; “makes stumbling” is rendered “works ruin.”
